propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, leaving it outside rebar's self-healing git seam while all other store paths inherit transient-fault recovery
fatal: bad object HEAD in CI occurs when the merge commit's loose object becomes unreadable at bundle time (proven by reproduction; trigger unproven)
the same transient class (missing object from ODB) is already handled elsewhere in gitutil via _TRANSIENT_HEAD_MARKERS and _INVALID_OBJECT_MARKERS
routing s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write and adding 'bad object' to the transient marker family makes the doctor inherit the per-store advisory lock and bounded retry without new code
S3DoctorConflict's default hint misdescribes an object-DB read failure as a heads conflict, sending operators to the wrong recovery tool
